name: dimforge/bevy_rapier
description: Official Rapier physics engine plugin for the Bevy game engine, providing 2D and 3D physics simulation via bevy_rapier2d and bevy_rapier3d crates. The standard way to add physics to Bevy-based games.
score_rationale: 1.5k-star official physics integration for the popular Bevy ECS game engine, essential for Rust game developers using Bevy.
summary: Official Rapier physics plugin for Bevy game engine
